## How I checked it

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run build && bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] Looked at it in `bun dev` (screenshot below for anything visible)

## Release

- [ ] Commits use a conventional type and scope (`lib`, `ui`, `demo`, …); `[skip bump]` on ones that shouldn't release
- [ ] No breaking change, or it is marked and meant as a new major (see `.github/AGENTS.md` §11)
